params.body:
The code of this repo is English; the checker for the house style was the one script with a Dutch name. `scripts/huis-lint.mjs` is now `scripts/brand-lint.mjs`, next to `brand/huisstijl.md` that it enforces; the guide and the README name it accordingly. Nothing inside the script changed.

First proposal with a deletion in it: control v0.16.0 lets a push remove a file, so a rename no longer needs a person's hand.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: brand-lint: the house-style checker under an English name
